purpose: Reapply the original pilot M3 PROCEDURAL rules to the existing 12 Phase-II cells. Exploratory post-result comparison, not an independent validation.

pilot_rule_sources.domain: first_science/phase4/m2_a2_nonadaptive_coverage.py _build_design; first_science/phase3/m1_joint_lift_v2.py build_search_bounds; ProviderC uses pilot expanded contract
pilot_rule_sources.mass: first_science/phase4/m3_v4_dominant_mass_graph.py; minimal prefix to 0.999 cumulative joint weight
pilot_rule_sources.graph_allocation: original greedy integer minimax allocation with B=1400

cv_rule: select lambda per new provider world by exact original blocked five-fold public-I1 validation; values lambda=30, top_k=14 above are PREPARE-stage compatibility placeholders, not production selection

freeze.source_candidate_domain: derive from each new world's PUBLIC I1 metadata with original pilot M1 bound-construction rule, including pilot's expanded ProviderC rule
freeze.protocol: 48 LHS / 100 CRN local / five-fold CV lambda / >=99.9% adaptive support / greedy minimax B1400
freeze.support_feasibility: hard stop if selected adaptive K>1400, never silently fix K or increase B
freeze.graph_reference: use Phase-II frozen 12-cell white-box reference only in evaluate after freeze
freeze.seeds: fresh disjoint graph RNG namespace, original 35000..35099 local seed bank

limitations: Different worlds and graph SLA conditions from the single pilot, so not bitwise replication of full experiment
ProviderC domain rule transfers the pilot's declared expanded-ProviderC M3 domain, not an independently repeated M1 boundary escalation
Results from already inspected Phase-II reference are retrospective and not a new holdout
